content_text:
Construction Materials Testing (CMT) Technicians
Entry-Level and Experienced Positions | Virginia, QLD
Australian Soil & Concrete Testing (ASCT) is seeking enthusiastic, reliable and motivated Entry-Level and Experienced Construction Materials Testing (CMT) Technicians to join our growing team at our new North Brisbane location in Virginia, QLD.
Whether you're looking to start a career in the construction materials testing industry or bring previous industry experience to an established team, we would love to hear from you!
About Us
Australian Soil & Concrete Testing's North Brisbane laboratory is based in Virginia and services a diverse range of clients across Everton Park, Chermside, Strathpine, Sandgate, Redcliffe, Caboolture and Caloundra.
ASCT is a NATA-accredited testing organisation providing comprehensive construction materials testing and geotechnical services. Our capabilities include soil and concrete testing and sampling, aggregate testing, primary testing, geotechnical investigations, environmental services, lime stabilisation and a range of specialised testing services.
We work with clients across residential, commercial and major infrastructure projects, delivering reliable testing services and technical expertise to ensure materials meet the required standards and project specifications.
At ASCT, we pride ourselves on our people, teamwork, safety and commitment to delivering quality results for our clients.
About the Role – What Does a CMT Technician Do?
As a Construction Materials Testing Technician, you will play an important role in supporting construction and infrastructure projects by testing and assessing materials to ensure they meet the required specifications and quality standards.
For entry-level candidates, you will receive hands-on training and work alongside experienced technicians who will help you develop the skills and knowledge required to succeed in the industry.
For experienced candidates, this is an opportunity to bring your existing technical knowledge and practical experience to a growing team.
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Travelling to construction sites, quarries and project locations to undertake field testing.
- Collecting and preparing samples of soil, concrete, aggregates and other construction materials.
- Performing laboratory and field tests in accordance with relevant Australian Standards and testing procedures.
- Ensuring testing is completed accurately, consistently and to the required quality standards.
- Recording and reporting test results.
- Working closely with site supervisors, engineers, clients and other project personnel.
- Maintaining a clean, organised and safe working environment.
- Developing your knowledge of industry standards, testing methods and quality requirements.
The role offers a combination of laboratory-based work and outdoor site work, providing variety and the opportunity to develop practical skills across different construction projects.
About You
At ASCT, we believe our success is built on teamwork, integrity, safety and the commitment of our people. We are looking for individuals who take pride in their work, demonstrate a positive attitude and are committed to delivering quality outcomes.
To be successful in this role, you will have the following attributes:
- A strong commitment to workplace health and safety, with a proactive approach to safe work practices.
- Pride in your work, with a strong focus on accuracy, attention to detail and quality outcomes.
- A positive attitude, motivation and willingness to learn and develop new skills.
- The ability to work independently with minimal supervision while contributing effectively as part of a team.
- Good physical fitness, including the ability to regularly lift loads of 20kg.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively under pressure.
- Confidence using computers and various software applications.
- A current driver's licence (essential).
- The ability to undertake and successfully pass scheduled and unscheduled drug and alcohol testing.
Previous experience in construction materials testing, civil construction, laboratory work or a related industry will be highly regarded but is not essential for entry-level applicants.
Why Join ASCT?
- Opportunity to commence or further develop your career in the construction materials testing industry.
- Hands-on training and support from experienced technicians.
- Exposure to a diverse range of construction and infrastructure projects.
- Opportunities to develop technical skills and industry qualifications.
- Join a supportive team that values safety, teamwork and quality workmanship.
- Competitive remuneration, with wages paid well above applicable award rates, recognising the skills, contribution and commitment of our people.
If you're motivated, reliable and looking for an opportunity to grow with an established and expanding company, we encourage you to apply!
